correctness.rationale: The exact logit recursion is verified algebraically and is strictly increasing for a<=4. A threshold trapping argument gives pointwise scaled iterates; monotone-map and continuous-limit bracketing upgrade it to compact-uniform convergence. The transformed Beta density has a continuous coercive rate and exponentially tight tails. Exponential equivalence transfers its LDP to finite-horizon averages; contraction correctly handles both interval endpoints. Bounded Varadhan optimization proves each pressure branch. 93 independent finite checks passed, not used as infinite proof.
